summary: The Embassy phase-1 experiment and controls are relocatable objects consumed by experiment composition, not standalone linked firmware ELFs.

rows.shim: Embassy dispatch hook, demo record and executor-stack publication
rows.other_side: the phase-1 experiment dispatcher and retained kernel wake path
rows.removal: the owned runtime is linked and entered through typed dispatch without the experiment hook

evidence.requirement: The demonstration and controls produce .o files rooted at embassy_on_dispatch, EMBASSY_DEMO and EMBASSY_STACKS; no standalone ELF is declared.
